Task bundles: [`counterexample`](https://github.com/conjectures-io/conjectures-tasks/tree/4bd1d01dd6193eec6b48eb6176ebdae9aa76a384/pool/tier-1/erdos-274-counterexample) · [`formalized`](https://github.com/conjectures-io/conjectures-tasks/tree/4bd1d01dd6193eec6b48eb6176ebdae9aa76a384/pool/tier-1/erdos-274-formalized)

> Let $G$ be a group, and let $A = \{a_1G_1, \dots, a_kG_k\}$ be a finite system of left cosets of subgroups $G_1, \dots, G_k$ of $G$. Herzog and Schönheim conjectured that if $A$ forms a partition of $G$ with $k > 1$, then the indices $[G:G_1], \dots, [G:G_k]$ cannot be distinct.
